title: Retrieval controls and chunk-level citations in the interface
description: Add a Retrieval section to Settings (default embedding model, reranker toggle), a collapsible Search index panel under the paper's Details tab for power users (profile, state, progress, change model, rebuild), chunk-level citation chips with section headings, and a 'How this answer was found' popover on answers. Keep the composer and thread uncluttered per DESIGN.md.
acceptance_criteria: Given Settings, when choosing a default embedding model, then new papers index with it and local models show install status.
Given a paper's Details tab, when a power user changes the index model, then indexing progress is shown and answers keep working meanwhile.
Given an answer citing two chunks on the same page, when rendered, then both citations are distinguishable and jump to the cited sentence.
Given an answer, when opening 'How this answer was found', then the query, retrieval mode, reranking and passages used are shown.
test_cases: Vitest/RTL component tests; generated OpenAPI types; Playwright updates for citation selectors, the Advanced panel and indexing progress.
